LESSON: SWADAQAH

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Swadaqah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Swadaqah. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What acts of swadaqah do Muslims perform?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify forms of swadaqah for character development
2. demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards
3. appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SWADAQAH
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Swadaqah helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SWADAQAH
Study Swadaqah like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify forms of swadaqah for character development

What this means
In this part you learn to identify forms of swadaqah for character development. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify forms of swadaqah for character development.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Swadaqah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify forms of swadaqah for character development. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Swadaqah in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Swadaqah is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Swadaqah” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify forms of swadaqah for character development)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Swadaqah in your own words. (skill: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Swadaqah to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify forms of swadaqah for character development.
3. Practise this skill: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the different forms of swadaqah in their daily life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Swadaqah from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Swadaqah: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Swadaqah?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What acts of swadaqah do Muslims perform?
2. What are the benefits of practising swadaqah?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Swadaqah means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify forms of swadaqah for character development.
5. Be able to: demonstrate different acts of swadaqah to earn rewards.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
